en: Soldier. Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head rectangular with parallel sides and a broadly rounded hind margin, the frontal region shallowly concave and the coronal suture indistinct. The third antennal segment is longer than the second and the fourth slightly longer still. Labrum with a straight apical margin and slightly rounded anterolateral corners. Mandibles long and strong with a projecting basal tubercle; the left carries five marginal teeth, the first broad and blunt, the second and fifth triangular and larger, the third and fourth short, blunt and small; the right has two very large teeth. Eye spot small and flat. Postmentum club-shaped with a straight fore margin and a narrow, markedly constricted waist. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head.
soldier: 兵蚁头壳淡黄褐，上颚黑褐，胸部与腹部黄白。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘宽圆，额区浅凹，Y形缝不显。触角第三节长于第二节，第四节又稍长于第二节。上唇端缘平直，前侧角稍圆。上颚长而壮，颚基峰突出；左上颚五枚缘齿，第一枚宽钝，第二与第五枚呈三角形而较大，第三、四枚短钝而小；右上颚二枚缘齿，甚大。眼点小而平，不鼓起。后颏棍棒状，前缘平直，前宽区无叶缺，腰部收缩明显而狭。前胸背板稍窄于头壳，前、后缘均浅凹，两侧缘圆出。
